flags.why: The expression concerns dominance within a limited locality, not believing oneself the best in a professional field ([dictionary](https://www.sachne.com/filedownload/09092025/tu-dien-thanh-ngu-tuc-ngu-viet-nam_10152025113525.pdf)).
flags.fix: Merge with sense 2: a big fish in a small pond; someone dominant only within a limited area.

flags.why: The adjective belongs to formal, ceremonial usage and needs a register warning ([VDict](https://vdict.com/video-anh%20linh%2C3%2C0%2C0.html)).
This is a literary word for a heroine, unsuitable as an unmarked everyday equivalent ([dictionary](https://tudientv.com/?t=anh+th%C6%B0)).
